change: Preserve integer cell/environment keys and use separate structured cell/user fields, avoiding signed/uint64 float promotion
before_fix: Accepted uint64 environment or user inputs raised TypeError in bincount after float64 promotion. Large unsigned user identities require exact grouping.

recorded_pipeline_types.cloud/prepare_27k.py: Nonbinary source columns, including user_id, are encoded as pa.int64
recorded_pipeline_types.randomized_cohort.exposure_environment: Environment codes are constructed using tab.astype(np.int16) and int8 duration groups

compatibility: Synthetic signed-int64 users and int16 environments match the original function exactly at four cohort sizes, and direct Python-set counting verifies distinct-user cells. UINT64 identities near 2**64 stay distinct.
scope: No original support tables, model weights, forecasts or scientific conclusions changed. No human inference rerun.
